mission: Write the first ideal customer profile (ICP) brief for NayaManas, a founder-led workflow automation and AI implementation agency, so that outreach and sales time goes to the prospects most likely to buy, succeed with an implementation, and refer others. Assumed intention: this is a qualification ICP for targeting and screening prospects, not a narrative buyer persona for marketing copy. If the evidence below cannot support a qualification ICP, say what is missing instead of writing a persona.
provisions:
[PASTE: notes from past engagements and pilots: client type, size, problem, outcome] [PASTE: recurring themes from discovery calls, with rough counts]
- Offer: workflow automation and AI implementation services, delivered by the founder [AND ANY CONTRACTORS]. - Capacity: [N] concurrent engagements; typical engagement [LENGTH] at [PRICE RANGE]. - Regions and languages served: [REGIONS]. - Known exclusions: [ANY WORK WE DO NOT TAKE, e.g. regulated data we cannot handle].

template.note: Format only. Do not reuse its content.

anchors.template: ## ICP: [Segment name] **One-line definition:** [who, size, situation] ## Defining characteristics | Attribute | Value | Basis | |---|---|---| | [Attribute] | [Value] | [Evidence or hypothesis] | ## Pain points 1. [Pain, in the customer's words] (Basis: [evidence or hypothesis]) ## Buying signals - [Observable signal], seen in [where it can be observed] ## Disqualifiers - [Signal that the prospect is not a fit] ## Open questions - [What would confirm or kill this ICP]

scope: - Define one ICP segment: the strongest one the evidence supports. Name a runner-up segment in one line at most. - Base characteristics on the pasted evidence; label anything else as a hypothesis. - Make every buying signal observable from outside the company (job posts, tooling, public statements, hiring) or in a first call. - Use only figures from the evidence; keep every bracketed placeholder as written, and leave statistics, market sizes and customer quotes out unless pasted.
success_spec: Output: a Markdown brief under 600 words that follows the template headings in order. Before returning, check: (1) every characteristic and pain point carries a Basis label, (2) each buying signal says where it can be observed, (3) there are at least three disqualifiers, (4) every number comes from the pasted evidence or is labelled as an estimate.
